# Crawloria

> Free AI Agent Optimization (AAO) audit tool. Paste any URL, get a 0-100 score with a sample agent-resolution render and prioritized fixes for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and other AI agents that browse the web on behalf of users. No signup, no email gate.

Crawloria measures how well a site works for vision-based and crawler-based AI agents. The scoring engine probes seven AI crawler User-Agents (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot, anthropic-ai, Google-Extended), inspects rendered DOM at the documented Anthropic Computer Use viewport, validates Schema.org and Open Graph metadata, checks for cookie/sign-up modal blockers, and surfaces real-time search visibility for the brand's category.

## Documentation

- [Methodology](https://www.crawloria.com/methodology): How Crawloria calculates the AI Agent Readiness score across six weighted categories. Bot Access (25%), Content Accessibility (20%), Structured Data (15%), Navigation Friction (15%), Agent Signals (15%), Semantic Markup (10%). Includes letter-grade bands and category-by-category check definitions.
- [Claim or remove an audit](https://www.crawloria.com/claim): How site owners can take ownership of, edit, or remove a public audit page. Audit pages are noindex by default, but they remain shareable public URLs.

## Try it

- [Run a free audit](https://www.crawloria.com): Paste any URL to scan. About 20 seconds. Returns a public audit page with score, sample render, and a prioritized issue list.
